requirement_text.REQ-004:
Depends on REQ-003 (done — merged into this run's branch), which added 'en' to src/i18n/routing.ts and seeded messages/en.json with every messages/ru.json key populated with a Russian-duplicated placeholder value. This requirement replaces every placeholder in messages/en.json with actual English copy, following docs/guides/content_ba_guide.md's voice/casing/vocabulary rules (§2's seven voice principles — functional operator-facing tone, no exclamation marks or slogans, §4's casing: sentence case for buttons/menu items, Title Case for section/page titles mapping to a domain noun, UPPERCASE MONO for status labels) applied directly, since English is the guide's own drafting language already (§4: 'draft with Russian and English both in mind'). Scope covers every string sourced from src/app/layout.tsx (title, description, OpenGraph/Twitter metadata) and all 12 landing components under src/components/landing/ (Band, Creed, Doors, Events, Footer, Hero, MapSection, Metrics, Nav, Partners, Streams, Team) as carried into messages/en.json by REQ-003.

Domain vocabulary decision: content_ba_guide.md §4 lists Event, Chapter, Talk, Speaker, CFP, Agenda, Check-in, Going, Watching as domain vocabulary to 'use verbatim, don't invent synonyms'. For messages/en.json, these terms are simply the correct English words in-language. Decision: use the exact same casing/form already established in content_ba_guide.md §4 and in messages/ru.json/messages/uz.json's verbatim usage (Event, Chapter, Talk, Speaker, CFP, Agenda, Check-in, Going, Watching) — do not substitute synonyms (e.g. not 'Session' for 'Talk,' not 'Registration' for 'Check-in') even though English drafting offers more synonym options than translation into another language does.

task.description: Per docs/agents/decisions/0002-content-ba-owns-message-catalogs.md: this is a pure content-writing task against an already-built structure (REQ-003 merged), so CODE-DESIGNER/CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR are skipped as inapplicable. Write real English copy directly into messages/en.json, replacing every Russian-duplicated placeholder, gated next by REVIEWER (not CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR). Follow content_ba_guide.md's voice/casing/vocabulary rules exactly, and this requirement's own domain-vocabulary decision above (verbatim domain terms, no synonym substitution).
acceptance_criteria: Every string key in messages/en.json has a non-empty value that is not byte-for-byte identical to the corresponding messages/ru.json value, except where a key's value consists solely of an untranslatable literal — event/date codes, country/role/brand names, URLs, numeric values, or proper product names — which are permitted to match verbatim
No Cyrillic characters appear anywhere in messages/en.json's values

The domain vocabulary terms (Event, Chapter, Talk, Speaker, CFP, Agenda, Check-in, Going, Watching) appear in messages/en.json using exactly the casing/form stated in content_ba_guide.md §4's list, with no synonym substitutions

The status-label keys (Streams.tsx's stream{N}Status keys and MapSection.tsx's chapter{N}Status keys) hold plain lowercase English values (e.g. 'upcoming', 'live', 'past'), matching the lowercase convention already used in messages/ru.json and messages/uz.json
No exclamation marks, slogans, or emoji appear in any messages/en.json value

result.summary: Replaced all 177 keys in messages/en.json with real English copy, translating from messages/ru.json's source meaning while following content_ba_guide.md's voice (functional, no exclamation marks/slogans), casing rules, and the requirement's domain-vocabulary decision (Event, Chapter, Talk, Speaker, CFP, Agenda, Check-in, Going, Watching used verbatim where they occur — Check-in/Agenda/Going/Watching are not present in this content's scope, so no forced insertion). Status-label keys (Streams.stream{N}Status, MapSection.chapter{N}Status) written as plain lowercase English ('live', 'in progress', 'planned', 'active') matching the ru.json/uz.json lowercase convention and the CSS-driven uppercase transform on .status. Dates normalized from Russian DD.MM.YYYY / 'DD month' phrasing to plain English forms (e.g. 'August 26', '04.25.2026' kept in numeric tab labels to match uz.json's numeric convention). 18 of 177 values intentionally left identical to messages/ru.json: brand name ('AI Qadam Build'), event/product name ('Fail Stories #1'), country/region codes ('UZ', 'UAE · SAIDE', etc.), an NPS acronym, a URL ('build.aiqadam.org'), a hashtag, a Telegram handle, a raw number string ('158 + 142'), and English-language job titles already correct in English (e.g. 'Co-founder', 'Board') — all fall under the acceptance criterion's untranslatable-literal exception.
